svg.aria-label: Exploded view of chips, thermal paste, metal lid and cooler on real grids. The older version falls gently, with a 4 degree gap between the lid and the cooler. The newer version has a 142 degree gap there. A separate check of that gap, using separately located layer maxima: 142 in the newer version, about 4 in two independent solvers, 3 in the older version.
